name: Default
shortDescription: Open source event management and ticketing platform with checkout, attendee check-in and organizer pages, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Registration is open: create your account at /auth/register right after deploying, then set APP_DISABLE_REGISTRATION to true so nobody else can sign up. For the admin area, open a terminal in the hi-events container, run php /app/backend/artisan user:make-superadmin 1 and confirm both prompts.

Tickets, invitations and password resets are sent by email. Mail is only written to the log until you set MAIL_MAILER to smtp with MAIL_HOST, MAIL_PORT, MAIL_USERNAME and MAIL_PASSWORD. Card payments need STRIPE_PUBLIC_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and a webhook to https://<your-domain>/api/public/webhooks/stripe with its STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
